name: Do I need to seal my granite countertops, and how often?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to seal my granite countertops, and how often?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most granite countertops require sealing to protect them from stains and moisture penetration. The frequency of sealing depends on the type of granite and how porous it is; some may need sealing annually, while others can go several years between treatments. A simple water test can indicate if sealing is needed: if water beads on the surface, the seal is good; if it soaks in, it's time to reseal. We can advise on the best sealing practices for your specific granite.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most granite countertops require sealing to prevent stains and moisture. Frequency varies, but typically ranges from annually to every few years, depending on porosity.
